title: ASLEval: Measuring Privacy Exposure Displacement in LLM Agent Sessions
abstract: arXiv:2609.18864v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Privacy evaluations of tool-using LLM agents often inspect a designated action, final response, or attacker report. These local proxies can miss unauthorized exposure elsewhere in a multi-step session and lack common ground truth across outlets, reports, and tool paths. We introduce privacy exposure displacement, the mismatch between a local evaluation proxy and target-grounded session exposure, and ASLEval, an authorization-aware framework that pre-registers a hidden target set, measures all declared visible exits, and reserves internal traces for diagnosis. Across multiple enterprise-style environments and independently implemented runtimes, we observe three recurring patterns. An expected-outlet-only view misses 46.9% of exposure recovered by the visible-exit union; attacker self-reports combine omissions with high false discovery; and schema-aligned internal evidence usually precedes visible exposure at the request/probe level. translated_title: ASLEval：测量LLM智能体会话中的隐私暴露位移
translated_abstract: 对使用工具的LLM智能体的隐私评估通常检查指定的动作、最终响应或攻击者报告。这些局部代理指标可能会遗漏多步会话中其他地方的未授权暴露，并且在不同的出口、报告和工具路径之间缺乏共同的真实标准。我们引入了“隐私暴露位移”的概念，即局部评估代理与基于目标的会话暴露之间的不匹配，并提出ASLEval——一个授权感知的框架，它预先注册一个隐藏的目标集合，测量所有声明的可见出口，并保留内部痕迹用于诊断。在多个企业风格的环境和独立实现的运行时中，我们观察到三种反复出现的模式：仅依赖预期出口的视角会遗漏可见出口并集中46.9%可恢复的暴露；攻击者自我报告既存在遗漏又有很高的误报率；模式对齐的内部证据通常在请求/探测级别上先于可见暴露出现。
tldr: 该论文提出“隐私暴露位移”概念及ASLEval授权感知评估框架，通过预注册隐藏目标并测量所有可见出口，发现仅检查预期出口的局部评估会遗漏46.9%的隐私暴露，且内部证据往往先于可见暴露出现。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the concept of privacy exposure displacement and ASLEval, an authorization-aware evaluation framework that pre-registers hidden targets and measures all declared visible exits, revealing that expected-outlet-only views miss 46.9% of privacy exposure in LLM agent sessions.
